data: Welcome to blackboard Chatbot, this friendly and helpful chatbot is here to assist you with your academic needs and makes your student life easier.
This Chatbot can answer your questions about your deadlines, exam, tutorial materials, or other studying questions.
To start chatting, just type in your question and send it. Please be aware that the chatbot unfortunately cannot generate pictures or voices.
Chatbot is always learning and improving, so feel free to give us your feedback and suggestions on how we can serve you better
